GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG383.7 (3 Jan 46) CIS
(SCAPIN-545)
3 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of KIHARA, Jitaro.
In accordance with orders of this headquarters, KIHARA, Jitaro, Saga-ken, Fujitsu-Gun, Nanaura-Mura, Yida, former consul at Davao, Philippine Islamds, has been apprehended and delivered to the authorities at Sugamo Prison for incarceration.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. Allen,
Colonel, A. G. D.
Asst. Adjutant General.
